key_catalyst: Escalating US-Iran tensions drive oil prices higher, dampening investor sentiment
reasoning: US-Iran tensions are actively escalating with 11 consecutive nights of strikes, Trump threatening Iranian nuclear facilities, Houthi maritime embargo against Saudi Arabia, and Brent crude at six-week highs with Goldman warning of $120+ potential. This is a novel, intensifying geopolitical catalyst the market has not absorbed — the modest -0.57% pre-market decline understates the severity. Additionally, rising Treasury yields at 4.634% with no stabilization provide a second open MODERATE-risk pressure on rate-sensitive QQQ holdings ahead of Big Tech earnings.
